title: Design: Empty Inactive tab keeps the column headings
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • No term is deactivated.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p4-03-a-new-shop-inactive-tab-empty.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the count pill reads 0; the column headings Name, Due, Customers and Vendors stay, and one centred grey row under them reads "No inactive terms", with a line under it (as in ct-p4-03-a-new-shop-inactive-tab-empty.png).
  • Step 2: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Held: the design's version; D-10 and S1-23 follow the PRD ("in place of the table"). Released or deleted when question 9 is answered (register CT-D02).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-N2: “If the Inactive tab has no terms, it shows the line "No inactive terms" in place of the table, and its count reads 0.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
